name: pr-line
description: One line under the prompt with the PR for the session's branch: CI, bot reviews, threads, people, and the next ship step

bots.title: Bot reviewers
bots.description: JSON: per repo (owner/name), the bot reviewers to wait on. Example: {"acme/app":[{"name":"Lint bot","reviewLogin":"lint-bot"},{"name":"Scan","checkRun":"Scan"}]}. Empty shows no bots column.

botCheckRuns.title: Bot check runs
botCheckRuns.description: Comma list of check-run names left out of the CI count (bots, deploy previews). A checkRun named under Bot reviewers is left out too.

stripPrefixes.title: Check name prefixes to cut
stripPrefixes.description: Comma list of prefixes cut from check names in the failing-CI text, e.g. ci/
